name: Annual one-off bonus, taxed separately (全年一次性奖金单独计税)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30: a resident’s qualifying annual one-off bonus (including year-end pay rises and a 13th month under 国税发〔2005〕9号) may be taxed apart from wages until 31 December 2027. No statute obliges a bonus or 13th month (register CN-N53); the amount is contractual.

name: Bonus in wages (奖金)
authority: STA 2018 No.61 art.6: a bonus not separately taxed is wage income of the month paid, withheld cumulatively. Contractual; no statutory amount (register CN-N53).

name: Economic compensation (经济补偿)
authority: LCL (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html) art.46: owed on art.36 where the employer proposed the mutual ending, art.38, art.40, art.41, art.44(1) fixed-term expiry unless the worker refused a renewal on equal or better terms, art.44(4)–(5); not on art.37 resignation or art.39 dismissal. art.47: one month’s wage per full year of service, six months to under a year a year, under six months half a month; a monthly wage above three times the city’s published prior-year monthly average is paid at three times that average for at most twelve years; the wage is the twelve months’ average before the ending. Implementing Regulation (https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=284) art.27: the wage due including bonuses, allowances and subsidies, floored at the local minimum wage; art.20: an art.40 ending without thirty days’ notice adds one month at the previous month’s wage; art.25 with LCL art.87: unlawful termination pays twice art.47 and no art.47 beside it. art.97 para.3: years count from 1 January 2008 (service months less lcl97_pre2008_months); the pre-2008 service is paid under the rules then in force as the recorded lcl97_pre2008_compensation, outside the art.47 cap. Regulation art.10: uncompensated service carried from a transferring employer (lcl10_transferred_service_months) counts. Regulation art.25: art.87 damages count every year from hire, so neither pre-2008 fact applies to them. The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage, defaulted per version (register CN-SH50, owner rule 2026-09-28). Taxed by IIT_SEVERANCE (财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1)); outside the SI and housing-fund bases.

name: Maternity allowance paid to the worker (生育津贴冲抵)
authority: Kunming maternity rules of 17 July 2024 (https://ybj.km.gov.cn/c/2024-07-25/4882692.shtml) item 17: the agency may pay the allowance to the employer or the worker; neither they nor 云政办发〔2011〕121号 (https://hrss.yn.gov.cn/jyj/NewsView.aspx?ClassID=1098&NewsID=52165, arts.12–13) state who bears a shortfall below the wage. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent; default: the employer tops up to the wage, because 女职工劳动保护特别规定 art.5 forbids reducing wages for birth and the Yunnan regulation pays 生育假 as maternity leave. MATERNITY_LEAVE is paid leave, so where the fund paid the allowance to the worker this line takes that allowance back off the wage the leave days priced: the worker keeps max(wage, allowance). The amount is the allowance the fund paid for this pay month’s leave days, recorded as the agency paid it; the line never exceeds the wage the salary window prices for its MATERNITY_LEAVE days (person.period.leave_pay: salary × leave days ÷ working days), so a part month takes back no more than the leave days’ wage. The allowance is a fund benefit, not wages, so the offset leaves the IIT base and the art.47 average. Where the fund paid the employer, no line is raised.
